Please familiarize yourself with the new features so that you can better understand the coming instructions for the mint tomorrow!

Sale Pre-Registration
Our Marketplace now has a new feature that allows for sale registration. For those of you that participated in our land sale, you may have noticed a bottleneck in performance on the queue entry (indicated by spinning circle for some). This new feature is designed to mitigate the load on our server which will eliminate the bottleneck. We are essentially removing a massive number of users flooding a single point of entry all at once. In addition, this registration process will make it harder for bots to participate. Here is how it will work… 
 
Prior to the sale, we will have a registration period in which a “register now” button will appear. This button will become available randomly for users at different times on the sale page. The minimum time eligible users will have to register is 5 minutes before the tier opens. 
 
When the register button goes live on your screen, you can begin the registration process. On the first step you will be presented with all the essential information about the current NFT sale (price, transaction fee, recommended amount of ADA, etc). 
 
After confirming this information, you will proceed to step 2 of the registration process by clicking “register” at the bottom right corner of the popup. On step two of the registration, you will be signing the transaction with whichever wallet you choose to mint with. After signing the transaction, you will be prompted to complete a captcha. After successfully completing the captcha you will see a “registration successful” pop up. At this point, all you need to do is wait for the sale to go live and you will be able to click “Enter Queue”, which will be a single click action, so no more frantically clicking through multiple steps and pasting in wallet passwords. 
 
Raffle Window  
The second feature we have added to our marketplace is a hybrid of both raffle/First Come First Served. This was designed in mind for those that do not have access to blazing fast internet speeds. It’s also another measure to reduce the success of bot accounts. Here is how it works:
 
Each tier of the sale will open with a raffle. Our team will decide on how many seconds the raffle will last based on a variety of factors, and the duration of the raffle window will be communicated before the sale. All valid entries received during the raffle window will stand an equal chance of being randomly selected for a successful reservation. It does not matter if your entry arrives in the first second of the raffle, or the last. All stand an equal chance. The unsuccessful raffle entries will also be notified. 

Once the raffle window closes, the sale will proceed seamlessly on a First Come First Served basis. If the tier did not sell out during the raffle window, the remaining supply will be allocated as usual to entries based on when they arrived. 

Please note that only 1 entry per user per sale tier is allowed. If we detect multiple entries, some or all of your entries will be disqualified. 
 
Use Cases 
Let’s say the tier has 500 NFTs, opens at 15:00 UTC, and has a raffle window of 30 seconds. Entries that arrive between 15:00:00 and 15:00:29.999999, will be considered in the raffle window, and entries that arrive from 15:00:30 onward, will be in the First Come First Served portion. 

If exactly 500 users submit valid entries in the raffle window, all entries will receive a successful reservation, and any entries arriving in the First Come First Served portion will be unsuccessful.

Cornucopians,  

We are very excited to announce the first official Cornucopias NFT Staking program. We value the community greatly and have spent considerable time on how to approach this reward program. That said, we have decided to run a shorter program of 3 months to test everything out. This will also allow us to explore creating a more advanced staking program using smart contracts. As always, we welcome any feedback so that we can continue to improve staking rewards as time goes on. 

So, onward to the details on the rewards!

This is a reward pool where you can stake both your ADA and your land NFTs. Neither of each asset have influence on the rewards of each other. That said, you can stake your ADA, your land NFTs, or BOTH!

By staking your ADA, you will earn ADA in addition to dripping COPI. By staking your land NFTs, you will be dripping COPI tokens. The COPI rewards will stack, so you do not need to drip them every epoch.

The land rewards will be earned per epoch and are different amounts based on size and rarity. This staking program does favor users who stake earliest, with the most rewards being earned in epoch 1, so don’t waste any time! We understand that the mint price of your land may vary drastically from the price paid on the secondary market. In our approach, we tried to balance this variable with all the benefits that come with each rarity as well as the number of each type of asset in circulation.

What are the requirements to earn on my land NFTs?

To earn COPI on your land you must:
1) Have all land NFTs in the wallet you plan to stake with
2) Use that same wallet and delegate ADA to our COPI stake pool
3) BOOM:  you earn copi on your staked ada AND you earn copi on each land NFT

IMPORTANT: To ensure that you do not miss any rewards, please plan to claim once per month on the same date.

When staking ADA, you will earn .0125 COPI for every one ADA staked per epoch, and will earn a loyalty bonus the longer you stake. You will also earn the ADA from the delegation protocol in addition to your COPI drip. 

We are scheduled to launch the staking program beginning on Epoch 360 (August 28th). We will follow up with additional instructions plus a video of how to go through this process and start earning ADA and COPI! (edited)

If Epoch n = Epoch 358 (Ending 21:44 UTC August 23rd) we can see that Epoch 359 would be a waiting period. Epoch 360 would be the first Epoch that the delegation would be "active". Rewards would then be calculated during Epoch 361, and we would see reward delivery in Epoch 362.

We have until just before 21:44 UTC August 23rd to have made our delegation in order to be in the snapshot. It is a good idea to get your delegation done as far in advance of the time above as possible.

note: If delegation is with another pool, and then delegation is moved to our COPI pool, rewards during the waiting period (epoch 359 in our example above) are still based on the delegation at the first pool. No Staking rewards are lost. (edited)

Cornucopians, 

What a tremendous showing of support, our pool has grown to over 20 million ada in just one week!

We have 3.5 million copi to distribute over 24 Epochs. Epoch 360 is our founders epoch in which anyone who stakes before the epoch change tomorrow will participate in at .0125 Copi per ada staked for that epoch (you must be delegated to COPI stake pool in the current epoch 358, to receive founders epoch rewards) 

From there, we are using an exponential decay function to reward early delegators with additional COPI.  This will gradually decline from a maximum of 240,000 COPI on Epoch 361 down to a maximum of 50,000 COPI on Epoch 383.  If the pool does not reach saturation, rewards will continue until the 3.5million COPI are depleted.

Your COPI rewards will stack so you only have to claim them on the DripDropz platform once per month.   (Don’t wait longer or you can lose rewards as they only stack for 7 epochs).

Please remember, this is not an ISPO (we are receiving regular 5% fees and you will still receive competitive ada rewards).  The point was for us to contribute to the decentralization of Cardano, earn a small stream of revenue to support the game build, and give you guys a bonus for a period to help us kickstart it.  The most rewards go to those participating the earliest.  Remember, you will still receive your ada rewards for the blocks we earn all along the way.  Thanks again for your support!

Land Staking Reward Breakdown

The land staking rewards are comprised of two parts - the base payout per epoch and the early staking incentive. The base COPI earned per epoch is what is shown in the graphic provided and is paid out regardless of when you stake your NFT. The early staking incentive is a bonus payout to incentivize you to stake your NFT as early as possible. The bonus is highest in epoch 1, providing an 82% boost to your base earnings, and then gradually declines each epoch, until epoch 18 which equals the base COPI amount.

COPI Team Update

To start, we want to thank all of you who participated in our most recent Custom Dome sale! What an amazing accomplishment for being in the depths of a bear market! The feedback we have received has been incredibly positive. Once again, our minting technology delivered a smooth experience for the majority of our community. Across all sales, we had over 22,000 queue entries with an average entry time of 3.9 seconds (don't worry time did not help anyone). 4,224 assets were minted through our raffle while only 25 were minted FCFS!

For this announcement, our team wanted to take this opportunity to provide an update in writing on an overall scope of all things Cornucopias!

Dome Staking
As a reminder, Dome Staking will be added to the rewards program after the closing of our current land staking program. We plan to implement smart contracts into the next phase of staking to allow for a more dynamic experience. 

Land Staking
For full details on how land staking works, please read this announcement:

In simplest terms, delegation and claiming works as follows (for this example we will assume you delegated on epoch 358): epoch 358 delegation to COPI pool, epoch 359 activation, epoch 360 making blocks, epoch 361 calculation of rewards, epoch 362 rewards paid

New Team Members
As of today, we introduced two new full time team members at our weekly staff meeting! We are super excited to bring on a new team member whose specialty is Microservices and DevOps - he also happens to be an OG Cardano developer (best of both worlds!). His role will be to continue with the progression of our desktop launcher in addition to network engineering for our games multiplayer functionalities. We look forward to the value he will bring on many fronts. We also brought on an additional artist that will assist in Blender and UE5 development for game assets. Perhaps you will meet them in a future COPI Cafe!

Future Hires
We of course are always looking for additional talent to join our development team. We have eyes on quite a bit of talent and will be adding team members as we identify particular needs as our game progresses!

Milestones Achieved!
Today, our team watched a live demo of our first attempt at multiplayer functionality. During our staff meeting, five of our developers were walking around Solace together as we discussed this incredible milestone for our game. This is something we had anticipated for 2023 so it’s outstanding to see the progress so early!

Also, as many of you know, we have upgraded our COPI stake pool to 1.35.3! We are ready for VASIL!

Outlook
Aside from what is already stated in our roadmap, we are aiming to accomplish quite a bit over the next few months. Our development team is ambitiously back on track with Sector production in tandem with preparing a few demos for our visit to CNFTCon in Vegas. They are also migrating all racing systems from UE4 to UE5.

I plan to put together these COPI Team Updates on a bi-weekly basis (weekly if possible) so that all of you can stay informed, especially those that do not have time to watch COPI Cafe!

Thank you all! (edited)
